tldr_zh: OpenAI強化資料隱私與安全，美機構對伊朗祭最嚴制裁，Tesla等三家公司獲準在內華達州部署數千台機器人計程車。
tldr_en: OpenAI enhances data privacy protections, US imposes strictest Iran sanctions, and Tesla, Uber, Waymo get approval to deploy thousands of robotaxis in Nevada.

items.title_zh: OpenAI推出AI Futures倡議探討AI治理與經濟影響
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches AI Futures Initiative on AI Governance
items.summary_zh: OpenAI推出新的部落格專欄「AI Futures」，探討轉型性AI將如何重塑權力結構、治理制度、經濟與個人自由。此舉反映OpenAI對AI政策與倫理議題日益重視，為即將進行的IPO做準備。
items.summary_en: OpenAI launched AI Futures, a new blog exploring how transformative AI could reshape power, governance, economy, and individual freedom. The initiative reflects the company's growing focus on AI policy and ethics ahead of its upcoming IPO.

items.title_zh: OpenAI推零資料保留政策強化企業隱私保護
items.title_en: OpenAI Offers Zero Data Retention for Advanced Models
items.summary_zh: OpenAI重申為合格API客戶提供零資料保留政策，並預覽Private Safety Processing功能，在不損害資料隱私的前提下進行AI安全性研究。此舉旨在解決企業對AI使用中敏感資料保護的顧慮。
items.summary_en: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy. This addresses enterprise concerns about sensitive data protection in AI deployments.

items.title_zh: Stampli利用ChatGPT Work加速產品發布週期68%
items.title_en: Stampli Cuts Product Launch Time by 68% with ChatGPT
items.summary_zh: 企業軟體公司Stampli利用OpenAI的Codex和ChatGPT Work，將原需數週的產品發布製作流程壓縮至數天，效率提升68%。此案例展現生成式AI在加速企業開發流程中的實際效益。
items.summary_en: Enterprise software company Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of product launch production into days, achieving 68% faster delivery. The case demonstrates generative AI's practical impact on accelerating enterprise development workflows.

items.title_zh: Tesla等三家公司獲准在內華達州部署數千台機器人計程車
items.title_en: Tesla, Uber, and Waymo Approved for Robotaxi Deployment in Nevada
items.summary_zh: 美國內華達州批准Tesla、Uber與Waymo在未來12個月內部署最多8,000台機器人計程車。此許可代表自動駕駛產業的重要進展，將加速無人駕駛計程車在美國的商業化部署。
items.summary_en: Nevada approved Tesla, Uber, and Waymo to deploy up to 8,000 robotaxis over the next 12 months. This milestone represents significant progress in autonomous vehicle commercialization in the United States.

items.title_zh: Google Discover導入AI對話優化功能自訂推薦內容
items.title_en: Google Discover Gets AI Chatbot-Powered Customization
items.summary_zh: Google於Google應用程式推出新功能，使用者可透過文字描述自訂Discover推薦内容，AI會自動調整推薦並記住用戶偏好。此舉強化Google利用生成式AI優化內容推薦體驗的策略。
items.summary_en: Google added AI-powered customization to Discover feed, allowing users to describe their preferences and automatically adjust recommendations. The feature enhances Google's strategy to leverage generative AI for content curation.

items.title_zh: OpenAI在企業用戶領域逆襲Anthropic市場份額增長
items.title_en: OpenAI Gains Ground on Anthropic in Enterprise Market
items.summary_zh: 最新數據顯示OpenAI在企業用戶市場中的佔有率相比Anthropic持續上升。業界分析認為，隨著兩家公司持續發布新模型，企業客戶在選擇供應商上的不穩定性值得關注，可能對投資者信心造成影響。
items.summary_en: Recent data indicates OpenAI is gaining market share among enterprise users compared to Anthropic. Analysts note that enterprise volatility in switching between providers amid continuous model releases raises concerns about the stickiness of enterprise AI spending.

items.title_zh: Google與Marvell AI晶片合作擴大採購規模至1,200億美元
items.title_en: Google Expands AI Chip Partnership with Marvell for $120B
items.summary_zh: Google與晶片設計公司Marvell Technology於7月簽署商業協議，擴大開發客製化AI晶片的合作，Google未來採購規模預估達1,200億美元。此舉反映Google減少對NVIDIA依賴、開發自有AI基礎設施的長期戰略。
items.summary_en: Google signed a major partnership with Marvell Technology to develop custom AI chips, with potential procurement reaching $120 billion. The deal reflects Google's strategy to reduce NVIDIA dependence and build proprietary AI infrastructure.

items.title_zh: ChatGPT整合Apple訊息應用自動撰寫文字新功能
items.title_en: ChatGPT Integrates with Apple Messages for Text Composition
items.summary_zh: ChatGPT推出Apple訊息應用程式外掛，使用者可利用AI自動撰寫和編輯簡訊。此整合展示OpenAI持續擴展其在蘋果生態系中的應用版圖，強化日常生活中的AI助手角色。
items.summary_en: ChatGPT launched integration with Apple Messages, allowing users to automatically compose and edit text messages using AI. The integration demonstrates OpenAI's expanding presence in Apple's ecosystem and AI assistant capabilities in daily workflows.

items.title_zh: Roblox兒童安全措施遭澳洲監管機構批評未符規定
items.title_en: Roblox Fails Child Safety Compliance in Australia Review
items.summary_zh: 澳洲線上安全監管機構eSafety測試發現，Roblox未充分實施防止成人與未滿16歲兒童接觸的安全措施，違反澳洲《線上安全法》。Roblox承諾進行改善，成為首家接受獨立審查的平台。
items.summary_en: Australia's eSafety regulator found Roblox failed to adequately prevent contact between adults and children under 16, violating the Online Safety Act. Roblox committed to improvements, becoming the first platform subject to independent compliance audits.

items.title_zh: 波蘭醫療軟體商MyDr遭駭客攻擊近1,900萬人資料外洩
items.title_en: Polish EHR System Breach Exposes 19M Patient Records
items.summary_zh: 波蘭主要電子病歷供應商MyDr遭網路攻擊，可能外洩近1,900萬人的敏感醫療資訊，影響超過1.2萬家醫療機構。攻擊者可能存取至2024年4月的歷史資料，包括處方、預約與醫師文件等，波蘭政府正在調查。
items.summary_en: Polish EHR provider MyDr suffered a breach exposing sensitive medical data of approximately 19 million people, affecting over 12,000 healthcare institutions. Attackers may have accessed historical data through April 2024, including prescriptions and physician records, under government investigation.

items.title_zh: 美國宣布對伊朗實施史上最嚴厲制裁敦促中國配合
items.title_en: US Announces Historic Sanctions on Iran, Urges Chinese Cooperation
items.summary_zh: 美國財政部長貝森特表示，美國將對伊朗實施「史上最嚴厲制裁」，並敦促北京與華府當局合作。美方預定24日召開記者會公布制裁詳情。此舉進一步升級美伊對立局面。
items.summary_en: US Treasury Secretary Bessen announced historic sanctions against Iran and urged China to cooperate. The US plans to detail the sanctions in a press conference on August 24, further escalating US-Iran tensions.

items.title_zh: 俄軍發動大規模攻擊烏克蘭首都基輔至少17人喪生
items.title_en: Russia Launches Massive Attack on Kyiv, 17+ Killed
items.summary_zh: 俄羅斯對烏克蘭首都基輔發動大規模攻擊，基輔市長克里琴科表示至少17人喪生，關鍵民生基礎設施遭破壞，包括熱水供應中斷。此次攻擊再次凸顯俄烏戰爭對平民的嚴重威脅。
items.summary_en: Russia launched a massive attack on Kyiv, killing at least 17 people and damaging critical infrastructure including hot water supply systems. Kyiv Mayor Klitschko confirmed the assault targeted civilian infrastructure, highlighting ongoing threats to the population.

items.title_zh: 台灣國防預算首度破兆美媒解讀向華府北京發信號
items.title_en: Taiwan Defense Budget Exceeds NT$1 Trillion for First Time
items.summary_zh: 台灣行政院核定116年度國防預算達新台幣1兆1,225億元，首度突破兆元大關，占GDP比重超過3%。美媒指出此舉向華府表明台灣正投資自我防衛並準備採購美製武器，同時向北京發出警告信號。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's defense budget reached NT$1.1225 trillion for the first time, exceeding 3% of GDP. US media analysts view this as signaling to Washington that Taiwan is investing in self-defense and willing to purchase US weapons, while also warning Beijing.
